exposure: blood donation frequency (nondonors, low-frequency donors, high-frequency donors)
cohort: 14996 women with singleton pregnancies at full-term from Ningbo Medical Center Lihuili Hospital and Ningbo Women's and Children's Hospital from November 2019 to November 2020
finding: Blood donation in the 3 years before pregnancy was not associated with reduced neonatal birth weight but may be associated with an increased risk of fetal macrosomia.
